dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the dorsal surface. Each features a high-contrast light-intensity boundary approximately 10-20 pixels thick with a sharp interior gradient transitioning toward a dark core. One large, irregular 'O' is located mid-dorsal, flanked by two smaller fragmented 'C' shapes on the upper flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-pixel clusters that lack internal gradients. These are concentrated on the anterior-lateral region near the neck and along the lower lateral margin above the posterior flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form a wide-angle obtuse triangle. A secondary set of keypoints formed by the centroids of the two largest annuli and the most prominent anterior blob forms an acute triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast white pixel patches are located within the interdigital webbing of the posterior flipper, creating a high-frequency contrast change against the dark claws.
